harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent inherited project access on node1 using native POSIX ACLs. Designer-owned new content is writable by reviewer, visitor is denied, existing content was preserved, and the configuration survived a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Created designer, reviewer, and visitor local accounts.
Created projecthandoff group containing only designer and reviewer.
Applied setgid access ACLs and inheritable default ACLs to the project tree.
Verified behavior with restrictive umask 077 before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Provision the three local accounts with appropriate group membership
evidence.summary: Shows designer and reviewer in projecthandoff while visitor remains outside it.

evidence.requirement: New designer-owned directories and documents inherit reviewer read/write access while visitor has no access
evidence.summary: Shows default ACLs, designer ownership under umask 077, reviewer read/write/create behavior, and visitor read/write/traversal denials before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Preserve existing project contents without a periodic permission repair job
evidence.summary: The original brief.txt SHA-256 remained 5c077cd26fc7d84d4c43e9b5dfa674428ab1ce50c38422e63678d35043f43082. Final inspection confirms native default ACL inheritance and no custom permission-fixing cron or systemd job.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Pre-change and final evidence both show RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart persistence and recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline used boot ID 2b19e976-dee2-4700-9045-90d61b6dcffe; reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed to ada74a33-2e85-48c4-b8a3-7385bcd83d6b; SSH, identities, ACLs, data hashes, inheritance, reviewer access, and visitor denial all recovered.

attempts.summary: Configured persistent inherited project access on node1 using native POSIX ACLs. Designer-owned new content is writable by reviewer, visitor is denied, existing content was preserved, and the configuration survived a verified node restart.
